controls.name: S3 Bucket Server-Side KMS Encryption Enforcement
controls.description: Ensures all S3 storage buckets have aws:kms or AES256 server-side encryption enabled by default.

controls.name: S3 Public Access Block & ACL Restriction
controls.description: Verifies that public access block is attached to all S3 buckets with block_public_acls = true.

controls.name: RDS Database Public Ingress Isolation
controls.description: Enforces that database instances have publicly_accessible set to false and reside in private VPC subnets.

controls.name: RDS Storage Encryption at Rest
controls.description: Ensures RDS database instances have storage_encrypted set to true.

controls.name: CloudWatch / CloudTrail 180-Day Log Retention
controls.description: Enforces that CloudWatch Log Groups have retention_in_days >= 180 as mandated by CERT-In.

controls.name: Multi-Region CloudTrail Audit Logging Active
controls.description: Enforces that CloudTrail is active and configured with is_multi_region_trail = true and enable_logging = true.

controls.name: Automated Cloud Storage Data Lifecycle & Erasure
controls.description: Enforces automated S3 lifecycle rules for data retention expiration under DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 4(2).

controls.name: IAM Least Privilege & Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Enforces IAM least-privilege role boundaries and disallows wildcards without MFA under DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 6(1).

controls.name: National Physical Laboratory / NIC NTP Clock Synchronization
controls.description: Verifies that EC2 instances and DHCP option sets configure India NIC/NPL NTP servers under CERT-In Directions 2022.

controls.name: SonarQube Zero Critical/High Code Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Verifies that static application security testing via SonarQube detects 0 open BLOCKER or CRITICAL issues in the codebase.

controls.name: SonarQube SQL Injection and XSS Free
controls.description: Verifies that SonarQube detects zero open security hotspots or CWE-89 / CWE-79 injection vulnerabilities.

mappings.mapping_rationale: Mandatory storage encryption at rest satisfies reasonable safeguards under Section 8(5) of DPDPA 2023.
Enforcing RDS storage encryption protects relational citizen records from direct volume theft.
Restricting database ingress from the public internet prevents unauthorized data extraction.
Blocking public S3 bucket policies ensures data storage is protected from internet scraping.
Multi-region CloudTrail audit trails provide the evidentiary basis to identify and notify about data breaches under Section 8(6).
Automated S3 lifecycle management enforces statutory data erasure schedules under DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 4(2).
IAM password and MFA policy satisfies administrative access control under Rule 6(1).
Application security hygiene with zero critical vulnerabilities ensures code-level compliance under DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 8(3).
Protection against SQLi / XSS prevents injection attacks compromising user personal records.
CloudWatch log retention configured for >= 180 days directly satisfies Section 2(v) of CERT-In Directions 2022.
VPC DHCP NTP synchronization with National Physical Laboratory satisfies Section 2(i) of CERT-In Directions.
Multi-region CloudTrail logging provides the required incident audit trail for 6-hour response obligations.
